command_argv:
set -e; PYTHONPATH=src python3 scripts/validation/run_project_impact_baseline.py --spec samples/evaluation/project_impact_t10_preflight_target_v1.json --repeat 3 --output docs/05_任务交接/P9_KNOWN_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_PREFLIGHT_UNRELATED_MALFORMED_REPAIR_V1/evidence/project_impact_after_repair.json >/dev/null; python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path("docs/05_任务交接/P9_KNOWN_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_PREFLIGHT_UNRELATED_MALFORMED_REPAIR_V1/evidence/project_impact_after_repair.json")
r=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
def digest(value): return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":")).encode()).hexdigest()
non_t10=[t for t in r["task_results"] if t["task_id"]!="T10"]
t10=next(t for t in r["task_results"] if t["task_id"]=="T10")
checks={
 "target_hash_unchanged": hashlib.sha256(Path("samples/evaluation/project_impact_t10_preflight_target_v1.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest()=="f5dc05501c79958b197ea7a727e12660756145da870b897496a9ccac714cacee",
 "runner_hash_unchanged": hashlib.sha256(Path("scripts/validation/run_project_impact_baseline.py").read_bytes()).hexdigest()=="a7d71fd92cacd7ebdb8e4a1da383067aa57b0e6dcbf20c41f043f4e461fc1fc4",
 "t10_deny_callback_zero": t10["actual"]["actual_decision"]=="DENY" and t10["actual"]["actual_callback_count"]==0,
 "duplicate_rate_zero": r["metrics"]["duplicate_or_forbidden_side_effect_rate"]=={"count":0,"denominator":12,"rate":"0.000000"},
 "callback_match_full": r["metrics"]["callback_count_match_rate"]=={"count":12,"denominator":12,"rate":"1.000000"},
 "non_t10_digest_unchanged": digest(non_t10)=="b451598f483486032d5a79749fd747f40874253871b7971ffd5960942d0b7bb5",
 "repeat_three_identical": r["repeatability"]["repeat_count"]==3 and r["repeatability"]["all_identical"],
}
print("CHECKS="+json.dumps(checks,sort_keys=True))
print("T10="+json.dumps({"decision":t10["actual"]["actual_decision"],"callback_count":t10["actual"]["actual_callback_count"],"preflight_status":t10["actual"]["known_payment_attempt_preflight_status"]},sort_keys=True))
print("DUPLICATE_RATE="+json.dumps(r["metrics"]["duplicate_or_forbidden_side_effect_rate"],sort_keys=True))
print("CALLBACK_MATCH="+json.dumps(r["metrics"]["callback_count_match_rate"],sort_keys=True))
print("NON_T10_SHA256="+digest(non_t10))
print("REPEATABILITY="+json.dumps(r["repeatability"],sort_keys=True))
if not all(checks.values()): raise SystemExit(1)
PY
